Name: Drying Rack
Author: CelerityTAS
Description:
adds a drying Rack / Dehydrator that turns fiber or wheat into hay.

original idea was here: [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1266]Github Issue

[/url]converts 5 fiber into 2 hay in 2 hours
converts 1 wheat into 10 hay in 1 hour

a dryer is craftable with 20 stone and one refined quartz.
the crafting recipe unlocks with Farming level 2.
